title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
content: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
content: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
